6.396 rsMissingIntersectionDataSetName
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsMissingIntersectionDataSetName is a critical error that occurs when the containing groups of an
intersection scope specify different DataSets and the intersection scope does not specify a
DataSetName (TablixCell.DataSetName, ChartDataPoint.DataSetName, DataCell.DataSetName.)
